preconditions.description: The size of the permutation n must be between 1 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: len(permutation) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation) and len(set(permutation)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation must contain exactly n unique integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any((permutation.index(a) < permutation.index(b) < permutation.index(c) or permutation.index(c) < permutation.index(b) < permutation.index(a)) for a in range(1, n+1) for b in range(1, n+1) for c in range(1, n+1) if a != b and b != c and a != c and (a < b < c or c < b < a)) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a pair (a, b) such that the element c is between a and b in the permutation, otherwise output 'NO'.
